elf_contract.facade_surfaces: libxslt facade exports xslt* + xslDebugStatus (version script, namespace-scoped); libexslt facade exports exslt*; neither leaks the combined core (court-verified)
elf_contract.mechanism: build.rs + .cargo/config.toml custom linker (tools/packaging/linker-wrapper.sh) -> tools/packaging/facade-gen.sh re-links the whole core from liblibxml_rs.a with --whole-archive, per-facade -Wl,-soname, version-script export filtering, and --no-as-needed -l: NEEDED entries; idempotent + flock-serialized; symlink fallback on non-Linux/cross/published-crate builds (documented distribution contract)
elf_contract.state_coherence: DOCUMENTED DIVERGENCE (R-000177): the whole-archive facades are the only consumer-linkable construction (thin re-export facades fail the consumer static link — modern ld refuses an undefined dynsym entry as a definition — and the core cannot satisfy the facades' references to the crate's mangled internal symbols). They therefore carry private copies of the core state: hooks/globals installed through one DSO are not observed by the others. The DSO-STATE-COHERENCE court pins the exact partition profile; the DSO-LOADER court verifies the ELF identities.
elf_contract.distribution_contract: The full Git repository (with .cargo/config.toml and tools/packaging/) is the C-custodian distribution — it builds the real three-DSO contract. The crates.io package excludes tools/ and .cargo/ (Cargo.toml exclude), so published-crate builds use the default linker and the symlink fallback: every SONAME name resolves to the single core liblibxml_rs.so instance (Rust-consumption artifact).

amendment_scope: 1. FUNCTION-SIGNATURE ABI PLANE (R-000176): new ABI-FUNCTION-SIGNATURE court mirrors every export across oracle header / candidate header / actual Rust extern "C" signature (3319 compared, 0 findings). Caught the xmlGcMemSetup class — xmlMemSetup/xmlMemGet/xmlGcMemSetup/xmlGcMemGet took four arguments (missing mallocAtomicFunc), returned nothing (header says int), and on x86-64 SysV misread five registers (RDX mallocAtomic read as realloc, RCX realloc as strdup) — plus shifted layouts (xmlC14NExecute 6-vs-7 args with a completely different contract; xmlAutomataNewCountTrans/xmlAutomataNewOnceTrans swapped min/max with data), 20+ stale pre-2.10 signatures (*Ext*/xsltSetCtxtLocaleHandlers/xsltSetLoaderFunc/xsltInitElemPreComp), candidate-header drift fixed to the oracle (xmlTextWriter* int returns, xmlDebugDumpNode depth arg, xmlParseURIReference/xmlURIUnescapeString returns, xmlNewTextReaderFilename 1-arg, xslt function-pointer typedefs), and the four legacy SAX v1 handlers became x86-64 variadic asm shims formatting the varargs (upstream xmlVFormatLegacyError).

2. ALLOCATOR SINGLE-SOURCE-OF-TRUTH: the five exported function-pointer variables (xmlFree/xmlMalloc/xmlMallocAtomic/xmlRealloc/xmlMemStrdup) ARE the allocator state (upstream globals.c); xmlMemSetup/xmlGcMemSetup validate NULLs (return -1), assign the variables (Gc assigns xmlMallocAtomic = mallocAtomicFunc) and return 0; xmlMemGet/xmlGcMemGet read them through NULL-tolerant outputs; the *Impl bodies are indirections through the variables so every internal allocation observes the override; the internal ALLOCATOR RwLock (two-sources-of-truth) is gone. ALLOCATOR-HOOK differential court (xmlMemSetup/get, Gc variant, direct public-variable assignment, NULL rejection) is byte-identical with the oracle.

3. DSO-STATE-COHERENCE COURT (R-000177): cross-DSO probe (install allocator/entity-loader/node-register/keepBlanks through -lxml2, run compile+transform through -lxslt). Oracle (shared instance): every observation True. Candidate whole-archive facades: fully partitioned (transform-phase allocator/register/deregister/loader observations all False, keepBlanks not shared — 56-byte result vs oracle 41). Thin re-export facades proven impossible (consumer static link fails; mangled-internal dependency). Accepted as a bounded divergence; the court pins the exact partition profile so silent architectural changes are caught.

4. CUSTODIAN-COMMENTARY-DRIFT COURT: every residual (R-\d{6}), court/probe/casefile ID, epoch (E-\d{3}) and courts/receipts path in source commentary resolves; embedded (N/N) court-verdict counts banned and removed (28 sites, e.g. DSO-LOADER (25/25) -> DSO-LOADER); granular coverage census — exports 1856/1856 documented, unsafe fns 1771/1811 documented, unsafe blocks 1737/5233 SAFETY-commented (baseline).

5. COUNTS + DISTRIBUTION CONTRACT: Cargo.toml/README narrative updated to 1181 tests and 78 FIXED / 3 OPEN (81 residuals); crates.io version 0.1.0-alpha.35; the repository-vs-crates.io distribution split (repo = real three-DSO C-custodian install; published crate = symlink-fallback Rust-consumption artifact) documented in build.rs.

residuals.open_disposition: R-000157 is OPEN/UNRESOLVED: a REAL current executed-platform gap (iconv/ICU-only encodings vs the Iconv+ICU-enabled 2.15.3 oracle) whose closure requires implementing an iconv/ICU backend — a future implementation work item, explicitly NOT waived. R-000168 is the bounded unexecuted-platform evidence obligation (Windows/macOS/BSD/32-bit runtime), documented per-obligation in atlas/PLATFORM_SURFACE_ATLAS.json. R-000177 is the documented cross-DSO state partitioning of the whole-archive facades, pinned by the DSO-STATE-COHERENCE court. CORRECTED ACCEPTANCE (supersedes the Z.1 phrasing): surface/evidence completeness is sealed for the executed platform; one known current implementation residual (R-000157) and the unexecuted-platform evidence obligation (R-000168) remain open and are explicitly deferred, and one bounded packaging divergence (R-000177) is accepted and court-pinned. There is no claim that open candidate-parity residuals = 0 — R-000157 is a genuine current executed-platform implementation gap.
